title: Joe Russo Explains Avengers: Doomsday Teasers Amid New Trailer Rumors
excerpt:
Hayley Atwell has fueled speculation about a November 23 trailer release.
Joe Russo says the film's marketing clues are designed to involve fans in its story.
body_md:
Speculation surrounding a new Avengers: Doomsday trailer has intensified after Hayley Atwell, who returns as Peggy Carter, mentioned a possible Monday, November 23 release while meeting fans. Her remark has not, by itself, established an officially confirmed trailer schedule.

Speaking at an industry event in Doha, co-director Joe Russo described a promotional strategy that differs substantially from the campaigns for Infinity War and Endgame. Audience behavior has changed, he argued, particularly through social media and the speed at which viewers discuss and reinterpret clues.

Russo explained that the team wanted to begin telling the story long before the theatrical opening. Character-focused teasers are intended to function as pieces of a larger narrative puzzle, rather than conventional advertisements alone. Fan responses also help the filmmakers understand which details audiences are following and which may be misunderstood.

Disney has separately announced a November 30 preview during an ABC holiday television special. The report suggests this could be distinct from the rumored November 23 release, but that distinction should not be treated as confirmed until further official information appears.

Russo also discussed why he and his brother Anthony returned to the Avengers franchise. Robert Downey Jr. initially raised the prospect during personal conversations, and his eventual involvement as Victor von Doom, or Doctor Doom, gave Russo a compelling creative reason to reconsider.

The film is scheduled to open on December 18, 2026. For now, the confirmed ABC preview, Atwell's remarks and fan predictions about a standalone trailer remain separate pieces of information with different levels of certainty.
seo_title: Joe Russo on Avengers: Doomsday Trailer Strategy
seo_description: Joe Russo discusses Avengers: Doomsday's fan-focused teasers as speculation grows over a possible November 23 trailer.
